children: Avalanche Treasury reported preliminary, unaudited third-quarter 2026 net income of approximately $54.6 million, or $1.53 per diluted share. Market-driven changes in the value of its AVAX holdings, including fair value changes and realized losses, contributed approximately $60 million in gains. The company also reported staking revenue of $0.6 million for the quarter and said it repaid its FalconX loan in full.
Preliminary net income was approximately $54.6 million, or $1.53 per diluted share.
Market-driven changes in the value of AVAX holdings, including fair value changes and realized losses, contributed approximately $60 million in gains.
Staking revenue, net of fees, was approximately $0.6 million for the quarter and $4.2 million for the first nine months of 2026.
General and administrative expenses were approximately $3.2 million.
Cash and USDC totaled $4.9 million; debt was $10.0 million outstanding after the FalconX loan was repaid and closed during the quarter.
Avalanche Treasury held 13.31 million AVAX as of September 30, 2026: 7.93 million unlocked and 5.38 million locked, with a weighted-average remaining lock period of approximately 16.5 months.

Approximately 91% of its AVAX, or roughly 12.1 million tokens, was staked throughout September. The company moved most of its treasury into staking during the third quarter after resolving post-combination regulatory and liquidity constraints.

The company repurchased 2,889,440 Class A shares at an average price of $1.14 per share, holding them as treasury shares. The repurchases represented approximately 8% of Class A shares outstanding as of August 24, 2026.

Avalanche ecosystem developments included institutional access to Goldman Sachs’ Financial Square Treasury Instruments Fund through Lynq, ICE’s evaluation of blockchains for a planned tokenized-securities platform, and a UAE partnership to bring Avalanche technology to the UAE PASS Digital Vault.

Paxos integrated AVAX and Avalanche-native USDC across its regulated infrastructure. Avalanche’s Helicon upgrade also activated on mainnet, shortening minimum validation periods and adding auto-renewing stakes.
